solutions.title: Nested scan
solutions.strategy: For every position, scan all values to its right to find the replacement.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each position may scan the suffix after it.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A new result array is returned.

solutions.title: Right suffix maximum
solutions.strategy: Scan from right to left, writing the best value seen so far before incorporating the current value.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The returned array stores n replacements.
